candidates.title: ROL: bounded-lookahead rollout LPT dispatch for P||Cmax
candidates.justification: novelty 2: mechanism class (rollout) established; exact instantiation not found in reachable indexes but increment-level only. usefulness 3: cheap deterministic drop-in after LPT with a validated regime of gain (small-n/moderate-m) and honest guidance that MULTIFIT is the stronger default baseline. provability 2: no proofs; empirical dominance over LPT (0/900 losses) is an observation, not a theorem. reproducibility 5: preregistered seeds/protocol, committed instances and raw outputs, one-command rerun, byte-identical determinism verified. improvement 3: robust significant improvement over LPT (p=1.15e-28 pooled, -39% mean gap) but does NOT beat MULTIFIT or full local search.
